items.label: Low-pressure re-exposure: how a design idea is reused
items.familiar_context: Review how one synthetic prototype contributes different characteristics to later components; no answer is required yet.
items.answer: The movable bracket's relocation behavior goes to the controller, while its mounting form goes to the weatherproof housing.

support_progression.label: Recognize the parts
support_progression.content: Notice the bracket, controller, and housing without answering.

support_progression.label: Follow one characteristic
support_progression.content: Track behavior separately from physical form.

support_progression.label: Change perspective
support_progression.content: Treat the prototype as one idea split across two later components.

support_progression.label: Explain it
support_progression.content: Describe in your own words where behavior and form went.
